title: Lebanon signs own monetary agreement with France
why: Search summary: Jan 1948 deal without Syria split the Lebanese pound from the Syrian one; unopened page, unconfirmed.

title: Customs union with Syria dissolved
why: Search summary: union ended 1950, spurring foreign and Arab banks in Beirut; month not confirmed, page not opened.

title: GDP per capita jumps 33% in one year
why: Maddison: 3,872 (1950) to 5,150 (1951) int$; start of the 1950s merchant boom.

title: 1950s boom peak: GDP per capita 7,010 int$
why: Maddison: 81% above the 1950 level (3,872 int$).

title: Banking Secrecy Law enacted
why: Law of 3 Sept 1956 aimed to attract Arab oil capital and deposits from Lebanese abroad.

title: 1958 crisis: GDP per capita falls 17%
why: Maddison: 6,599 (1957) to 5,510 (1958) int$, the year of the 1958 civil conflict.

title: Beirut becomes financial and business centre of Arab world
why: After independence Lebanon ran a free-trade economy dominated by banking, finance and tourism. Page states Beirut was financial and business centre of the Arab world pre-war; decade not specified.

title: Banque du Liban established
why: Central bank created 1 Aug 1963 (date corrected from 1963-08); not yet operating.

title: Banque du Liban fully operational
why: BDL becomes fully operational on 1 April 1964.

title: Electricite du Liban (EDL) created
why: Search summary: EDL set up July 1964 with an electricity monopoly; page not opened.

title: Intra Bank stops payments
why: Largest Lebanese bank; held 15% of all bank deposits. Its collapse halted the economy.

title: GDP per capita falls 7.6% after Intra and June war
why: Maddison: 6,811 (1966) to 6,295 (1967) int$. A formal bank moratorium was not confirmed.

title: Rebound: GDP per capita back to 6,876
why: Maddison: 1968 is above the 1966 level.

title: Oil-boom deposits flood Lebanese banks
why: Gulf petrodollar inflows boost deposits; not confirmed in any opened page.

title: Pre-war peak: GDP per capita 8,397 int$
why: Maddison high before the war; regained only in 2003.

title: Civil war begins; output falls by about half
why: Economy page: war cut national output by half; Maddison GDP per capita 8,384 (1974) to 2,442 (1976).

title: Trough of early war: GDP per capita 2,442
why: Maddison: a 71% fall from 1974.

title: After the war, state regains control of key ports
why: Economy page: central government retook ports and government facilities after 1990, ending militia control.

title: Civil-war emigration: about 990,000 fled
why: Diaspora page: around 990,000 people fled Lebanon during the war, many to the West.

title: Israeli invasion year: GDP per capita 2,823 int$
LBP still about 4.5 per USD
why: WB official average 4.53 in 1983, before the 1984-92 depreciation.

title: Lira collapse begins: 6.5 then 16.4 per USD
why: World Bank annual average official rate: 6.51 (1984), 16.42 (1985), 38.4 (1986).

title: Inflation hits 69% and accelerates
why: IMF WEO CPI inflation: 69.4% in 1985, 95.4% in 1986.

title: Hyperinflation: CPI +487%; LBP about 500 per USD
why: IMF WEO 487.2% inflation; Lebanese pound page: LL 500 in 1987; WB avg 224.6. Page confirms LL 500 per USD in 1987; CPI +487% is an IMF figure not on the page.

title: Inflation 155%; GDP per capita 4,385
why: IMF WEO 155%; Maddison GDP per capita down 29% in 1988.

title: War-era trough: GDP per capita 2,488 int$
why: Maddison: lowest since 1976; LBP 497 per USD average (WB).

title: War ends; LBP averages 695 per USD
why: World Bank official annual average 695 in 1990.

title: Post-war recovery starts: GDP per capita +40%
Lira collapse forces PM Karami to resign
why: Karami resigned May 1992 over the pound's fall against the dollar, which caused street riots (date corrected from 1992-05-06).

title: Lira passes 2,500 per USD; inflation near 100%
why: Pound page: over LL 2,500 in 1992; IMF CPI 99.8% (Hariri page says 131%); WB avg 1,713.

title: Rafik Hariri becomes PM (1992-98)
why: Start of aggressive stabilisation; Hariri page says inflation fell from 131% to 12% in two years (date corrected from 1992-10).

title: Horizon 2000 reconstruction plan launched
why: Government rebuilding plan; size cited variously $10-20bn (date corrected from broad 1993; March per search summary).

title: Stabilisation: inflation falls to 25%
Solidere founded for downtown Beirut reconstruction
why: Private company founded 5 May 1994 (date corrected from 1994-05), listed on the stock exchange.

title: Net public debt rises from 46% to 105% of GDP
why: MoF Country Profile 2004: net debt 46% (1992), 105% (1998) (replaces unverified gross 51.7%/108.2%); Hariri page: $2bn to $18bn.

title: Exchange rate fixed at 1,507.5 LBP per USD
why: Pound page: fixed from December 1997 until Feb 2023; WB avg 1,516 (1998), 1,507.5 from 1999.

title: GDP per capita recovers to 6,994 int$
why: Maddison: by 1999 at 85% of the 1973 peak.

title: Gross debt 136% of GDP; WB central govt 128.6%
why: MoF gross debt 136% (1999), 153% (2000); World Bank central govt 107% (1998), 128.6% (1999). MoF Country Profile 2004 table: gross public debt 136% of GDP in 1999 (153% in 2000); the WB 128.6% figure not re-checked.

title: Inflation falls to 0.2% under the peg
why: IMF WEO: 0.2% in 1999 after 99.8% in 1992.

title: Deflation era: CPI -0.4%; GDP per capita 7,406
why: IMF WEO: prices fall 2000-01 as the peg holds and growth stalls.

title: Paris II: $4.4bn in concessionary loans pledged
why: MEED: $3bn earmarked to cut debt service, then about 90% of revenue; Saudi $700m, France $500m.

title: Rafik Hariri assassinated
why: Karami page: killing on 14 Feb 2005 sparked protests and the resignation of the pro-Syrian government.

title: 34-day war damages roads, bridges and airport
why: War ran 12 July-14 Aug 2006; 640km roads, 73 bridges, 15,000 homes hit (date corrected from 2006-07).

title: Public debt peaks near 183% of GDP
why: IMF WEO gross debt: 183.3% (2006), then 169.3% (2007).

title: Paris III: about $7.6bn pledged
why: Chirac announced $7.6bn pledged; Saudi Arabia over $1bn.

title: Post-war boom: growth averages 9.1% a year
why: Economy page: average growth 9.1% between 2007 and 2010; the 2009 deposit-inflow claim is not verified.

title: GDP per capita 12,479 int$; inflation 10.7%
why: Maddison 2008; IMF CPI 10.7% despite the peg (food and fuel).

title: GDP per capita +12.5%; nominal GDP +21%
why: Maddison 12,479 to 14,039 int$; WB nominal GDP 29.1bn to 35.4bn USD.

title: GDP per capita 15,622 int$
why: Maddison: near peak; the series high is 16,285 in 2012.

title: GDP per capita peaks at 16,285 int$
why: Maddison: all-time high; debt 131% of GDP per IMF.

title: Syria war slowdown: growth averages 1.7%
why: Economy page: average 1.7% growth over 2011-2016, 1.5% in 2017.

title: GDP per capita falls 20% across the Syria-war years
Syrian refugees: about 1.1 to 1.5 million
why: HRW 2016: 1.1m refugees, highest per capita worldwide; World Bank-cited 1.5m on Economy page. HRW Aug 2016: 1.1m refugees; Economy of Lebanon page cites 1.5m.

title: Naameh landfill closes; garbage crisis begins
why: Closure began the crisis; You Stink protests started 8 Aug 2015.

title: Deflation: CPI -3.7%
why: IMF WEO 2015 CPI.

title: BDL starts 'financial engineering' operations
why: Liquidity page dates it to 2016 slowdown; BDL page says starting in 2015 (date conflict).

title: CEDRE conference: $11bn pledged
why: $10.2bn loans and $860m grants; World Bank $4bn over five years.

title: Nominal GDP peaks at $54.9bn
why: World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.CD peak before the crisis.

title: Moody's downgrades Lebanon to Caa1
why: Search summaries: 21 Jan 2019, default risk; Fitch CCC later in 2019 not checked.

title: Dollar shortage: black-market rate starts diverging
why: Liquidity page: crisis fully apparent Aug 2019; black-market rate diverged from the 1,507.5 official rate.

title: Protests erupt; banks close for two weeks
why: First large demonstration 17 Oct; banks then restricted dollar withdrawals without formal capital controls.

title: Debt 172% of GDP; GDP per capita 12,855
why: IMF WEO gross debt 171.9%; Maddison 12,855 int$, down 21% from the 2012 peak.

title: EDL deficits: about $43bn, 46% of public debt
why: Search summary of an analysis: cumulative EDL deficit; page not opened, figure unconfirmed.

title: Remittances rise from 13% to 33% of GDP
why: World Bank BX.TRF.PWKR.DT.GD.ZS: 13.3% (2002) to 33.3% (2023).

title: Emigration waves after 2006 war and from 2019
why: Not confirmed in any opened page; diaspora page only covers civil-war exodus.

title: LBP about 3.2 per USD under fixed rate
why: World Bank annual average 3.17 (1960); range 2.3-3.3 until 1979.

title: GDP per capita 7,084 int$
why: Maddison: 44% above 1960 by 1973.

title: LBP still 3.24 per USD; GDP per capita 4,536
why: Official rate stable while output had fallen 46% from the 1973 peak.

title: Inflation 24% as war economy erodes
Inflation 72%
why: IMF WEO 72.2%; WB avg LBP 497 per USD.

title: Market rate 1,600 (Q4 2019) then about 3,000 (Apr 2020)
why: Liquidity page figures; by Mar 2021 14,000 (or 10,000 per pound page), Jun 2021 15,200.

title: Official rate reset from 1,507.5 to 15,000
why: First official devaluation in 25 years; official rate later set to 89,500 in 2024.
